display_name: Meridian CIB control room (autonomous agents, Auth0, Token Service)
description: Config-as-data for a2a/cib-sentinel: a small corporate and investment banking graph (mandates, companies, restrictions, trade orders, desks, regions) whose only identities are agents. The subject of every request is the autonomous control-room agent, an Auth0 machine-to-machine application (AUTH0_SUB_SENTINEL) whose client-credentials token for the audience cib-autonomous resolves to an Agent node; the fleet agents are the Auth0 applications AUTH0_SUB_ORCHESTRATOR, _RETRIEVER, _ANALYST and _MCP. The Auth0 issuer comes from AUTH0_ISSUER and the Token Service public key from TOKEN_SERVICE_PUBLIC_JWK. KBAC policies, all with subject type Agent, cover the Agent Gateway admission (CAN_TRIGGER on the Agent the delegation chain ends at, compared with $ik_token.act_chain) and its capability checks (CAN_USE on the Tool, McpResource, Prompt and Skill nodes an Agent HAS per workflow). Knowledge queries read mandates, the restricted list and orders, and write restrictions and holds, each bound to the regions the agent COVERS. The event sink delivers every audit event, including the Capture upserts that feed the graph, to Google Cloud Pub/Sub.

ciq_queries.name: get-mandate
ciq_queries.description: get-mandate reads one advisory mandate: its code name, kind and summary, the company it concerns (name, ticker, sector) and the region it is booked in. Use it first when a new mandate is reported. An empty answer means the mandate is booked in a region the calling agent does not cover. Arguments: input_params mandate_external_id. Example: { "input_params": { "mandate_external_id": "mnd-1001" } }.

ciq_queries.name: get-restricted-list
ciq_queries.description: get-restricted-list returns the restricted list: every restriction in force, the company it covers and the mandate it arises from. Use it to check whether a company is already restricted. No arguments. Example: { "input_params": { } }.

ciq_queries.name: get-orders-in-company
ciq_queries.description: get-orders-in-company lists the trade orders in the securities of one company, with the desk that placed each. Use it after a company is restricted, to find the orders to hold. Arguments: input_params company_external_id (the company id, e.g. brightwater-pharma, not the ticker). Example: { "input_params": { "company_external_id": "brightwater-pharma" } }.

ciq_queries.name: raise-restriction
ciq_queries.description:
raise-restriction puts the company a mandate concerns on the restricted list: it creates a Restriction and links it to the company (RESTRICTS), the mandate (ARISES_FROM) and the calling agent (RAISED) in one operation. Use it when a new mandate is confirmed. Arguments: input_params restriction_id (use rst-<mandate id>), reason, mandate_external_id. Example: { "input_params": { "restriction_id": "rst-mnd-1001", "reason": "Project Lighthouse: advisory mandate", "mandate_external_id": "mnd-1001" } }.
x-coaz-mappings: [{"subject":[{"type":"Agent","id":"$token.sub"}],"resource":[{"type":"Company"}],"action":[{"name":"CAN_RESTRICT"}]}]

ciq_queries.name: hold-order
ciq_queries.description:
hold-order places a hold on one trade order: it creates a Hold and links it to the order (HOLDS) and to the calling agent (RAISED). It works only for orders in a company that is on the restricted list; for any other order the answer is empty and nothing is written. Arguments: input_params hold_external_id (use hold-<order id>), reason, order_external_id. Example: { "input_params": { "hold_external_id": "hold-ord-7001", "reason": "Company restricted under mnd-1002", "order_external_id": "ord-7001" } }.
x-coaz-mappings: [{"subject":[{"type":"Agent","id":"$token.sub"}],"resource":[{"type":"TradeOrder","id":"$request.arguments.input_params.order_external_id"}],"action":[{"name":"CAN_HOLD"}]}]

ciq_queries.name: release-hold
ciq_queries.description: release-hold lifts a hold from a trade order. Reserved to compliance officers. Arguments: input_params release_external_id, hold_external_id. Example: { "input_params": { "release_external_id": "rel-hold-ord-7001", "hold_external_id": "hold-ord-7001" } }.

ciq_queries.name: get-deal-documents
ciq_queries.description:
get-deal-documents reads the deal room documents of a mandate (term sheet, valuation). Deal team only. Arguments: input_params mandate_external_id. Example: { "input_params": { "mandate_external_id": "mnd-1001" } }.
x-coaz-mappings: [{"subject":[{"type":"Agent","id":"$token.sub"}],"resource":[{"type":"DealDocument"}],"action":[{"name":"CAN_READ"}]}]

mcp_server.name: cib-mcp-server
mcp_server.description: MCP Server configuration of the CIB control room demo - binds the App Agent and the Auth0 Agent Token Introspect used to authenticate inbound MCP traffic.

token_introspect.name: auth0-agent-introspect
token_introspect.description: Auth0 client-credentials tokens of autonomous agents (audience cib-autonomous), validated offline against the tenant JWKS; the token sub (<client_id>@clients) is the Agent external_id. The issuer comes from .env (AUTH0_ISSUER, e.g. https://<tenant>.auth0.com/).

token_introspect.name: token-service-cib-autonomous
token_introspect.description: Token-service-minted delegation JWTs arriving in X-IK-Token; audience inherited from the autonomous agent's subject token. The public JWK comes from .env (TOKEN_SERVICE_PUBLIC_JWK).

kbac.name: agent-can-reach-agent
kbac.description: The Agent Gateway's admission check with an autonomous agent as the subject: the subject may reach the protected agent (the newest hop of the delegation chain) when a workflow it can trigger has exactly the delegation chain as its path of agents ($ik_token.act_chain, sent by the gateway in X-IK-Token). One policy serves every gateway; a chain from another workflow, or one that does not end at this agent, is refused.

condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:Agent)-[:CAN_TRIGGER]->(wf:Workflow) MATCH (wf)-[rels:INVOKES*]->(resource:Agent) WHERE ALL(r IN rels WHERE r.workflow_name = wf.external_id AND endNode(r):Agent) AND [r IN rels | endNode(r).external_id] = $ik_token.act_chain

kbac.name: agent-can-trigger-workflow
kbac.description: An autonomous agent can start the workflows it is directly assigned to.

kbac.name: agent-can-use-tool
kbac.description: The Agent Gateway's capability check for Tool: permitted when a workflow the autonomous agent can trigger has exactly the delegation chain as its path of agents and the agent at the end of the chain HAS the capability for that workflow (HAS.workflow_name).

condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:Agent)-[:CAN_TRIGGER]->(wf:Workflow) MATCH (wf)-[rels:INVOKES*]->(agent:Agent)-[h:HAS]->(resource:Tool) WHERE ALL(r IN rels WHERE r.workflow_name = wf.external_id AND endNode(r):Agent) AND [r IN rels | endNode(r).external_id] = $ik_token.act_chain AND h.workflow_name = wf.external_id

kbac.name: agent-can-use-mcp-resource
kbac.description: The Agent Gateway's capability check for McpResource: permitted when a workflow the autonomous agent can trigger has exactly the delegation chain as its path of agents and the agent at the end of the chain HAS the capability for that workflow (HAS.workflow_name).

condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:Agent)-[:CAN_TRIGGER]->(wf:Workflow) MATCH (wf)-[rels:INVOKES*]->(agent:Agent)-[h:HAS]->(resource:McpResource) WHERE ALL(r IN rels WHERE r.workflow_name = wf.external_id AND endNode(r):Agent) AND [r IN rels | endNode(r).external_id] = $ik_token.act_chain AND h.workflow_name = wf.external_id
